tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List every tool of Private AI Tools, or the tools of one category, with their page URL. The tools run in the user's web browser: give the user the link. Files are never sent to this server or to the assistant.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Details of one tool by its slug (from find_tools or list_tools): name, description, page URL in every language, and the in-page agent tools (WebMCP) that a browser agent can call once the page is open.
